questionPrompt: Read the speaking response below. Select every grammar error you notice by highlighting it. You may also type the correct version in the box that appears.
passageText: Last year I visited Hanoi for the first time. Before I went there, I already heard many great things about the city. By the time I arrived, my friend already booked a hotel for us. I was surprised because I never saw such a beautiful city before that trip.

falseAlarmZones.hint: 'For the first time' is correctly used here.

errors.explanation: The hearing happened before the visit. Use past perfect: 'had already heard'.
The booking happened before the arrival. Use past perfect: 'had already booked'.
The experience of not seeing was before the trip. Use past perfect: 'had never seen'.
